findings.title: Duty-split discriminator is factually false for the imperative fit() handle
findings.detail: Requirement says the convergence duty applies to 'geometryReadyRef 를 읽거나 쓰는 다섯 지점' including the imperative fit() handle, and excludes requestViewportSync because it 'geometryReadyRef 를 만지지 않으므로'. Code: the imperative fit() handle (TerminalView.tsx:2991-2997) calls submitTerminalFit(term) with no callbacks (2995) and submitTerminalFit (1107-1129) never touches geometryReadyRef; all geometryReadyRef writes are 1206/3178/3876/4129/4233/4321 and reads 610/633/1073/2570/3148/4072 - none inside 2991-2997. Applied consistently, the stated criterion would exclude the imperative fit() handle too, contradicting AC-3.

findings.title: M3 half-closed: Rationale caller list still omits 1513
findings.detail: Rationale: '(호출부 1229 / 2335 / 2517)'. Trace Links: 'its callers are 1229, 1513, 2335 and 2517'. Two enumerations of the same set disagree inside one block; the omitted 1513 (requestViewportSync(term) after a large write, fitFirst defaulting to false) is the call site that makes M-C reachable.

findings.title: AC-8 is under-determined on the fitFirst axis and its parenthetical contradicts its own control
findings.detail: AC-8 defines the case as '렌더 불가로 fit 을 skip 한 경우(TerminalView.tsx:1163 의 fitFirst 및 isRenderable 조건이 거짓)'. Read literally the parenthetical makes the conjunction-false case normative, which includes fitFirst=false with a renderable container - taken on every large write at call site 1513 - and that directly contradicts AC-8's own control ('렌더 가능 상태에서는 남지 않는지'). The prescribed test does not fix the fitFirst argument, so an implementation gating the signal on '!isRenderable' and one gating on 'fitFirst && !isRenderable' both claim conformance while producing different results for the same prescribed observation.

findings.title: AC-8's observable is gated by debug capture; the vacuity precondition is unstated
findings.detail: recordTerminalDebugEvent returns immediately unless store.isEnabled(sessionId). AC-8's only observable is 'other dimension-check sites와 동일한' skip signal, i.e. that gated event. With capture disabled both AC-8 observations (signal present when non-renderable, signal absent when renderable) collapse to 'no event', so a conforming test passes on an unimplemented behaviour. The sibling REL-BGSTAB-018 states exactly this class of premise explicitly (AC-7 shadow-mode / admission-mode guard plus AC-8 boundary controls); REL-BGSTAB-017 states no such premise for AC-4 or AC-8.

findings.title: 'the only skip site that leaves nothing observable' is contradicted by the same block
findings.detail: Both drop the '0-size' qualifier the Rationale keeps. Rationale bullet 2 (srs:4281) states the imperative fit() handle '비가시면 디버그 이벤트조차 남기지 않고 조용히 반환' (TerminalView.tsx:2992), and AC-3 treats that as a skip. So requestViewportSync is not the only skip site that leaves nothing observable. Same shape as the previously fixed 'Rationale claimed all four sites detect 0-size' defect.

findings.detail: The field gives per-AC recipes for AC-4 and AC-7 but says nothing about AC-8. REL-BGSTAB-018 updated its Verification Method when its AC-7/AC-8 were added. The AC-8 text carries its own recipe so no information is lost.
